label: end-of-episode ramp (last ~10 trials) at unrewarded D1 and S1 D2 steps
explanation: An episode-clock unit. It is silent for episode trials 0-89 (12 of 11012 dev activations are in trials 80-89) and 99.9% of activations fall in trials 90-99. These coincide with the lowest value-head bin (value < 5.22, which holds 100% of activations), so the unit tracks time left in the episode (or low remaining value). Within that window activation grows trial by trial toward the episode end; the example windows show it rising monotonically across consecutive trials. It fires on D1 steps where no reward is shown (in_rew = 1 essentially never fires: 1 activation) and on D2 steps, strongest when S1 is reached (in_state S1: 2.8x lift, 55% of mass; S2: 0.5x). It almost never fires at GO (1.6% of mass). Binary scoring is limited because the onset is graded: ep_trial >= 90 & not GO & no reward gets recall 0.95 at precision 0.22, and the recorded ep_trial >= 95 version trades recall for precision (dev F1 0.67, mass recall 0.86). Its value is mainly in its magnitude as a ramp. Choice, transition, reward and the hidden good state add little beyond these conditions. d1_err steps also fire at a high rate (16x) but are rare.
